decision_rationale: The title and abstract present GENA-LM as a family of transformer-based foundational DNA language models with pre-trained versions for fine-tuning. The full text also describes pre-training and tokenization for model pre-training, supporting both generative and foundation-model characteristics.
evidence_snippet: "a suite of transformer-based foundational DNA language models"; "pre-trained versions of GENA-LM"; "models for pre-training" with BPE tokenization for language model pre-training; "fine-tuning" on downstream tasks; "recurrent transformer-based architecture" for long DNA sequences.
